properties.description: Hourly safety net. Fires at :10 past every hour and processes the PREVIOUS hour, passing dt/hour derived from the trigger's scheduled time. The storage-event trigger handles the common case (a batch lands, process it immediately); this schedule catches the hour that the event trigger missed — a dropped event notification, or a batch that landed during an ADF outage. Belt and suspenders: events for latency, schedule for completeness.
